title: Installed Flows open straight into phase 1; the model picker moves to the run slide beside its cogwheel
description: Clicking a Ready Flow skips the detail slide-over and opens the frame, whose phase 1 already carries the same title, hero and description. The model picker follows to the run slide and pairs with the LoRA cogwheel, which drops its slot label - the dropdown names the model, so 'Render model' / 'Edit model' stop being invented per flow. Read brief.md.
acceptance: Clicking a flow tile whose availability is Ready, while the current page is the Gallery, closes the Flow Library and emits flow:open directly - no detail slide-over
A flow that is NOT Ready, or a Ready flow clicked from Landing, still opens the slide-over: that is where Install, the aggregated progress bar and Cancel-all live

The run slide renders one row per model slot: a dropdown when the slot has more than one INSTALLED candidate, a static model name when it has one, and an icon-only LoRA cogwheel to its right when the slot declares loras: true

The run-slide picker offers INSTALLED candidates only - picking an uninstalled one inside an open flow flips the flow unavailable and Run dies on a toast. The Library picker keeps offering uninstalled candidates, which is MPI-599's choose-what-to-download and must not regress
Klein 9B and Klein 4B are told apart in both pickers by one shared helper exported from modelRegistry.js, not by two copies of the sizeTierLetter logic
The slot label renders ONLY when a flow declares two or more model slots. No shipped flow does, so 'Render model' and 'Edit model' leave the UI with no descriptor edits

The LoRA cogwheel is REMOVED from the Flow Library slide-over: it was duplicated there (MPI-608) and on the run slide (MPI-613), and the drawer now only ever shows an uninstalled flow, whose rack is unreachable anyway
A pick rebuilds the model row in place, never the whole slide - _renderSlide tears down and replays the result pane

tests/flow-lora-rack.test.cjs and tests/desktop/flow-lora-button.spec.js are updated: both pin shapes this card deliberately reverses (the Library cog markup, and the assertion that the slot must label itself rather than read Model)
npm test and npm run test:desktop are green
docs/playbooks/add-flow/any-of-models.md and 04-overlay-and-shell.md match what shipped - the latter's flow diagram still routes every open through the slide-over

attention.reason: Both permission-gated follow-ups done: the component-mounts map is healed and 04 is split under budget.
